samples.question: A 3x3 grid of cells is shown; each cell is either filled (solid dark) or hollow (an outline). The orange ring marks the target cell whose state you must report. To the right, three operator boxes read left to right. Each box holds one colored disk in the left, middle, or right slot, giving a row or column index 1, 2, or 3. A red disk toggles that row and a blue disk toggles that column, flipping every cell in it. Applying the operators in order, what is the final state of the ringed target cell? Answer 'filled' or 'outline'.
